targets.review_note: Text specifies 10x15 RGB board, four-neighbor components, removal only at size>=2, gravity down then empty columns shift left, maximum component priority followed by leftmost then bottommost cell. Store bottom-up columns, scan columns left-to-right and rows bottom-to-top; retain first component on ties. Remove actual connected component, independently compress each column then discard empty columns. Track (m-2)^2 and bonus1000 only when board empty. Sample establishes bottom-left 1-based move coordinates; diagram is illustrative since gravity and rules are textual. Output required move record and final score, including blank separators from explicit format.
